output.summary: A tree-like cactus found in the Mexican states of Puebla, Tlaxcala and Oaxaca. Its pads bear silky white-to-yellow hairs, while its flowers are pink to reddish purple. The round red fruits are edible but covered with spines, hairs and tiny barbed bristles.
